answer: An hostile operator therefore has to keep each extra identity continuously active for 44 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The jetty counter is kept in inlet and mirror shows each reset. A bond is refunded only after 44 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. Repeating the trick 20 times costs 21 separate deposits and 6 separate proofs of work. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
